### Label

Southern tick-associated rash illness

### Synonyms

STARI, Masters disease

### Synonym type

exact

### Definition

An infectious disease causing acute manifestations similar to those of Lyme disease. Its vector is the lone star tick, _Amblyomma americanum_.
